## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-2-b9bf2e92`

Apply the same division-by-zero guard to ca_min_mg_per_l and mg_min_mg_per_l that was applied to gh_min_d. In update_molt_stress (shrimp.rs:459,464), ca_stress and mg_stress divide by params.ca_min_mg_per_l and params.mg_min_mg_per_l respectively without a .max(0.01) guard. Similarly, molt_mineral_modifier (shrimp.rs:1559-1560) divides by ca_min_mg_per_l and mg_min_mg_per_l without guards. If a user sets these parameters to zero (as the test_zero_gh_min_parameter_uses_defensive_guard test exercises for gh_min_d), NaN/Inf propagates through stress and molt calculations.

### `fr-2-4af528d5`

The new snapshot-side `dominant_repro_suppression` implementation in `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:375` does not match the real reproduction model. It omits the molt-stress factor used by `update_reproductive_readiness` at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:679`, folds TAN and nitrite into a generic `chemistry` bucket instead of the separate `tan`/`nitrite` diagnostics in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1572` and `:1574`, and uses different suppression curves/floors than the shared helper starting at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1548`. Even after the compile error is fixed, `repro_dominant_suppression` can disagree with the actual readiness calculation and mislead debugging.
